definitions.full: H4662. miphqad מִפְקָד noun [masculine] muster, appointment, appointed place ; — absolute ׳מ only in הַמּ ׳שַׁעַר Neh 3:31 , see שַׁעַר ; construct ׃מִפְקַד 1 muster of people 2Sam 24:9 = 1Chr 21:5 . 2 appointment of (by) Hezekiah 2Chr 31:13 . 3 appointed place of (in) temple Ezek 43:21 (Krae watch, guardhouse ; Kö ii. 1, 93 conjecture מוֺקֵד ).
